etymologies.etymologyHTML: From Latin frequentia, from frequens. English equivalent frequent +‎ -cy.

definitions.definition: (uncountable or countable) The rate of occurrence of anything; the relationship between incidence and time period.
(uncountable) The property of occurring often rather than infrequently.
